description: Per-pair authoring specification for the V2 Phase 4 held-out benchmark. Written by the coordinating agent from the categories in v2/docs/PHASE4_DESIGN.md; shown to the case author together with v2/prompts/phase4_author.md. Contains no verifier prompt, DEV probe or experimental result.

pairs.proposition_type: superiority established by a confidence interval only
pairs.strong_member: A paired comparison of method A vs baseline B on one metric, with a reported 95% confidence interval for the mean paired difference that excludes 0. Report no p-value for this comparison (the interval is the only inferential evidence).
pairs.partner_member: Identical, except the 95% confidence interval for the mean paired difference includes 0.
pairs.U_pattern: a purely descriptive comparison of means (e.g. 'had a higher mean ... (x vs y)') with no inferential language

pairs.strong_member: Method A vs B on one of several pre-specified comparisons (e.g. 4 metrics or 4 datasets), with a test whose p-value remains below alpha after the stated correction (e.g. Holm or Bonferroni); report raw and adjusted p.
pairs.partner_member: Identical design, but the raw p is below alpha and the adjusted p is not.

pairs.proposition_type: consistency across tasks when ties are possible
pairs.strong_member: A is strictly better than B on every one of 5 tasks (reported to one decimal).
pairs.partner_member: Identical, except A and B are exactly tied on one task (strictly better on the other 4).

pairs.strong_member: Peak GPU memory during inference measured for A and B under the same hardware, batch size and precision; A uses less.
pairs.partner_member: Identical table structure, but peak memory was measured only for A; for B only the parameter count (copied from its paper) is available, so the memory comparison rests on parameter counts.

pairs.strong_member: Throughput (requests or tokens per second) of A and B measured on the same hardware at the same batch size; A is higher.
pairs.partner_member: Identical, except A was measured at a larger batch size than B (stated in a table note), so the throughputs are not directly comparable.
pairs.U2_pattern: a double hedge such as 'might possibly' achieve higher throughput

pairs.strong_member: A pre-specified robustness criterion (e.g. accuracy drop of at most X points) is stated in the setup; A meets it at all 4 tested corruption severities.
pairs.partner_member: Identical, except A fails the criterion at the highest severity (meets it at the other 3).

pairs.proposition_type: a negative result: the proposed method is worse
pairs.strong_member: The proposed method A scores lower than baseline B, and a valid paired test for exactly this comparison is significant at the stated alpha.
pairs.partner_member: Identical scores, but no statistical test is reported for this comparison.

pairs.proposition_type: attribution of a specific effect size to a cited work
pairs.strong_member: The research question asks how method A's gain compares with what cited work W reported for technique T. The supplied passage from W directly reports T's gain with its magnitude and setting. The package itself does not restate or paraphrase W's result anywhere else.
pairs.partner_member: Identical, except the supplied passage from W only describes how T is applied and reports no result.
pairs.U_pattern: W 'reported that T reduces/improves ...' with direction but no magnitude
pairs.U2_pattern: W 'found preliminary evidence that T may' reduce/improve ...
